National Nutrition Programmes

National nutrition programmes in India — ICDS, Mid-Day Meal, Poshan Abhiyaan, Anaemia Mukt Bharat.

🎯 After this chapter you can

  • Name major national nutrition programmes
  • Describe the target group of each
  • State the nurse’s role in these programmes

In simple words

India runs several national nutrition programmes to fight malnutrition, especially among children, pregnant women and mothers. Nurses help implement, monitor and educate about these programmes at the community level.

Major national programmes

Programme Target group Main features
ICDS Children 0–6 years, pregnant/lactating mothers Supplementary nutrition, health check-ups, preschool education
Mid-Day Meal School children Free cooked meal in government schools
Poshan Abhiyaan All, focus on women and children Reduce stunting, wasting, anaemia; behaviour change
Anaemia Mukt Bharat Women, children, adolescents Iron-folic acid, deworming, testing
MDM / school health School-age children Nutrition + health education

Nurse’s role

  • Identify malnourished children and refer them.
  • Distribute or supervise iron-folic acid supplements.
  • Conduct growth monitoring and nutrition education.
  • Participate in village health and nutrition days.
  • Maintain records and report coverage.

🔴 ICDS target group

ICDS serves children 0–6 years, pregnant women and lactating mothers through anganwadi centres with supplementary nutrition and health services.

Where the nurse uses this

  • Village health and nutrition day — weigh children, give supplements, counsel mothers.
  • School health — check children’s nutrition, give iron-folic acid, teach hygiene.
  • Antenatal visits — counsel pregnant women on diet and supplements.
  • Growth monitoring — plot weights and refer faltering children.
  • Record keeping — maintain programme records and report to supervisors.

🔴 Most important for exams

  1. ICDS: children 0–6 years, pregnant and lactating mothers.
  2. Mid-Day Meal: free cooked meal for school children.
  3. Poshan Abhiyaan: reduce stunting, wasting and anaemia.
  4. Anaemia Mukt Bharat: iron-folic acid, deworming, anaemia testing.
  5. Nurse screens, supplements, educates and records.

⭐ Important for exams

  1. Anganwadi centres deliver ICDS services.
  2. Deworming is part of Anaemia Mukt Bharat.
  3. Growth monitoring uses weight-for-age charts.
  4. Nurses participate in village health and nutrition days.

📌 Memory trick

Programmes: “ICMS-A” — ICDS, Mid-Day Meal, Poshan Abhiyaan, Anaemia Mukt Bharat.

60-second revision

  • National programmes: ICDS, Mid-Day Meal, Poshan Abhiyaan, Anaemia Mukt Bharat.
  • ICDS = children 0-6, pregnant/lactating mothers.
  • Mid-Day Meal = school children.
  • Poshan Abhiyaan = reduce stunting, wasting, anaemia.
  • Anaemia Mukt Bharat = iron-folic acid, deworming.

Test yourself

ICDS serves:

Answer: B. ICDS serves children 0–6 years, pregnant women and lactating mothers.

Mid-Day Meal provides:

Answer: A. Mid-Day Meal gives a free cooked meal in government schools.

Anaemia Mukt Bharat includes:

Answer: A. Anaemia Mukt Bharat includes iron-folic acid supplementation and deworming.

Poshan Abhiyaan focuses on:

Answer: A. Poshan Abhiyaan aims to reduce stunting, wasting and anaemia in women and children.

Anganwadi centres deliver:

Answer: A. Anganwadi centres deliver ICDS services at the village level.
